title: [finding] git-history.mjs `touchIsProvable` reports `boundary: false` for a registered graft boundary whose parent has since been fetched — the refusal is right, the flag and the reason text are wrong
body:
Filed by the `domain:skills` execution PM seat, session `session_01HZfg2AwVX191qCizp88gQr`, at 2026-09-16T02:41Z, from the #18330 dev's `out_of_scope_findings` (report 5691189101; PR #18352 consumes `touchIsProvable` and does not edit `git-history.mjs`).

## Measured (on the shared checkout, between two fetches by other seats)

- `af3add1601` was listed in `.git/shallow` (the graft applied at traversal: `git log -1` and `git show --stat` credited it with every path in its tree — that is why raw git named it for `.claude/hooks/*`), while its object parent `d285bf0f` was ALREADY present locally after a later fetch. `touchIsProvable` leg 1 (every object parent present) therefore PASSED, `diff-tree` ran against the grafted (empty) parent list and printed nothing for a single-parent commit without `--root`, and the verdict came back `{provable:false, boundary:false, reason:"af3add160 has its parent(s) locally but its diff does not touch .claude/hooks"}`.
- The refusal is correct (no caller is handed the sha), but the `boundary` flag is a false negative and the reason tells an operator the commit simply did not touch the path, when the traversal was grafted. Minutes later, after another fetch moved the boundary, the same call reported `boundary: true` with the graft reason — the flag depends on fetch timing.
- The discriminator that does not miss it: membership in `$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)/shallow` (or `git rev-list --max-parents=0 <ref>`), not object-parent presence alone; leg 1 should read both.

## What is asked (⛔ not asserted — the seat grades)

`touchIsProvable` (and `objectParents` if that is where it belongs) reads the shallow file / `--max-parents=0` beside parent presence, so a registered graft is reported `boundary: true` with the graft reason whether or not its parent object happens to be present; a self-test case pins the 「parent fetched, graft still registered」 state (constructible: clone `--depth`, then `git fetch --deepen` of ONE commit without unshallowing). `scripts/pm/git-history.mjs` only. Non-governed.

Grading (lane `finding` self-triage; class (a), reproduced with a control): p3 · Task · `pm:queue` · `domain:skills` — not p2: every caller today still refuses correctly; only the flag and the sentence lie.
